# Längsta nedgången på 25 år: "Mycket talar för korrelation"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-08-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This episode looks at the Stockholm stock exchange's longest losing streak in about 25 years, a nine-to-ten-day slide with unusually low volatility. The guests put it down to renewed Hormuz/oil tensions, inflation fears and rising long-term rates, including concern about US government debt. They still recommend being overweight equities, though not fully invested, because industry is picking up and the economy looks early in an upswing. The market is rewarding companies that deliver on sales, with value names and banks (Atlas Copco, Volvo) favoured into autumn, while companies that miss on top-line growth, such as AAK, get punished and pharma stocks are out of favour. European and German value, construction and infrastructure companies are also highlighted.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 AAK — AAK | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest says they are positive on AAK but expects it to remain ice cold for one or two quarters; it must deliver on top line first.

#### Reasoning

AAK was heavily sold off for failing to deliver on top-line growth in a market rewarding sales delivery. The guest's firm is positive on the name longer term but explicitly warns the next one to two quarters may stay weak until the company proves growth, suggesting a watch/accumulate-later stance rather than an immediate buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if top-line growth fails to recover in coming quarters
- if market continues to punish non-delivering companies

> *"De som är kalla, typ som AAK. Nu är vi positiva till dem, men första kvartalet eller två härifrån kan de vara ganska iskalla. De måste leverera först, sen investera."*

---

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest expects value companies like Atlas to have momentum into the autumn as industry picks up in early cycle upswing.

#### Reasoning

The guest sees the economy at the beginning of an economic upswing with industry gaining pace, and believes value/industrial names such as Atlas will carry momentum into autumn. Market currently rewards delivery on sales, favouring quality industrials.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Hormuz escalation causes an oil-driven meltdown
- if long rates keep rising on inflation rather than growth
- if industrial recovery stalls

> *"Ja, det tror jag. Det är bolag som Atlas, Volvo och även bank."*

---

### 🟢 VOLV-B — Volvo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named with Atlas and banks as value companies expected to have momentum into autumn amid industrial upswing.

#### Reasoning

Guest expects value stocks and cyclical industrials to lead into autumn given early-cycle recovery signals from industry. Volvo is cited explicitly as such a beneficiary.

#### Sell Triggers

- if industrial cycle reverses
- if oil shock from Hormuz hits demand
- if rising rates reflect inflation not growth

> *"Ja, det tror jag. Det är bolag som Atlas, Volvo och även bank."*
